The FloPlast 110mm push-fit access pipe is an essential component for any soil and vent drainage system, enabling inspection, testing, and maintenance. Constructed from robust, lightweight uPVC, this grey pipe offers excellent strength and long-term durability, suitable for high-temperature waste discharges in plumbing installations. Its straightforward push-fit mechanism, featuring reliable ring seal joints, ensures rapid and secure installation. With two 67mm boss inlets, it conveniently accepts 32, 40, and 50mm waste pipes through adaptors, providing versatile connection flexibility for trade professionals. The use of silicone lubricant on all seals will facilitate jointing.
